brief:
B'Tselem, an Israeli human rights organization, has warned that Israel is systematically working to eliminate viable living conditions for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, according to Middle East Eye. The group characterized the pattern as a deliberate effort to make life unliveable in the territory.

The organization's assessment comes amid ongoing restrictions and policies affecting Palestinian communities across the West Bank, though the report did not detail specific measures in the summary provided.

title: Israel systematically undermining Palestinian living conditions in West Bank, B'Tselem warns
